youtube_description:
Ever felt forgotten, like your struggle doesn't register with anyone? Psalm 9 says the needy will not always be forgotten (Psalm 9:18).

David calls God a stronghold for the oppressed (Psalm 9:9). The Hebrew word is misgav (mis-GAHV): a high, safe place, out of the enemy's reach. God sits enthroned forever and does not forget the cry of the afflicted (Psalm 9:7, 12), and he has not forsaken those who seek him (Psalm 9:10).

Today's step: write down one thing God has done for you, and thank him for it out loud.

Day 9 of the Psalms, one chapter a day. Follow @thebibleexplainedai so you don't miss Psalm 10.

Read it: Psalm 9:1-20

#Psalm9 #BibleStudy #Bible #Faith #Shorts
